def _parse_amount(token: str) -> int | None:
    if not token or not token.isascii() or not token.isdigit():
        return None
    return int(token)


def ledger(ops: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[int]]:
    balances: dict[str, int] = {}
    frozen: set[str] = set()
    history: list[tuple] = []
    rejected: list[int] = []

    for idx, op in enumerate(ops):
        if not op:
            rejected.append(idx)
            continue
        tokens = op.split(" ")
        if any(t == "" for t in tokens):
            rejected.append(idx)
            continue

        verb = tokens[0]

        if verb == "open":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            acc, amt_str = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            amt = _parse_amount(amt_str)
            if amt is None or amt < 0 or acc in balances:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            balances[acc] = amt
            history.append(("open", acc))

        elif verb == "deposit":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            acc, amt_str = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            amt = _parse_amount(amt_str)
            if amt is None or amt <= 0 or acc not in balances:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            balances[acc] += amt
            history.append(("deposit", acc, amt))

        elif verb == "withdraw":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            acc, amt_str = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            amt = _parse_amount(amt_str)
            if (
                amt is None
                or amt <= 0
                or acc not in balances
                or acc in frozen
                or balances[acc] < amt
            ):
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            balances[acc] -= amt
            history.append(("withdraw", acc, amt))

        elif verb == "transfer":
            if len(tokens) != 4:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            acc_a, acc_b, amt_str = tokens[1], tokens[2], tokens[3]
            amt = _parse_amount(amt_str)
            if (
                amt is None
                or amt <= 0
                or acc_a == acc_b
                or acc_a not in balances
                or acc_b not in balances
                or acc_a in frozen
                or balances[acc_a] < amt
            ):
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            balances[acc_a] -= amt
            balances[acc_b] += amt
            history.append(("transfer", acc_a, acc_b, amt))

        elif verb == "freeze":
            if len(tokens) != 2:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            acc = tokens[1]
            if acc not in balances or acc in frozen:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            frozen.add(acc)
            history.append(("freeze", acc))

        elif verb == "unfreeze":
            if len(tokens) != 2:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            acc = tokens[1]
            if acc not in balances or acc not in frozen:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            frozen.remove(acc)
            history.append(("unfreeze", acc))

        elif verb == "undo":
            if len(tokens) != 1 or not history:
                rejected.append(idx)
                continue
            last = history.pop()
            kind = last[0]
            if kind == "open":
                acc = last[1]
                del balances[acc]
                frozen.discard(acc)
            elif kind == "deposit":
                _, acc, amt = last
                balances[acc] -= amt
            elif kind == "withdraw":
                _, acc, amt = last
                balances[acc] += amt
            elif kind == "transfer":
                _, acc_a, acc_b, amt = last
                balances[acc_a] += amt
                balances[acc_b] -= amt
            elif kind == "freeze":
                acc = last[1]
                frozen.remove(acc)
            elif kind == "unfreeze":
                acc = last[1]
                frozen.add(acc)

        else:
            rejected.append(idx)

    return balances, rejected
